references.text: Refers to 'the place the Lord will choose', the same expression used in Joshua 9:27 regarding where the Gibeonites were to serve
Mentions 'the one who cuts your wood and the one who draws your water', the same service assigned to the Gibeonites
Earlier in the same chapter where the Gibeonites are given the role of woodcutters and water carriers
Joshua's curse on the Gibeonites as woodcutters and water carriers for God's house
The Gibeonites are mentioned in connection with Saul breaking his covenant with them, confirming their continued service
Temple servants (netinim), who possibly included descendants of the Gibeonites serving at the temple
